Voluntary strike off of Hamleys (Franchising) Limited 
This is to inform that in the application for voluntary strike off filed by Hamleys (Franchising) 
Limited (“HFL”), a step-down subsidiary of the Company, the Registrar of Companies, United 
Kingdom has published a notice in the gazette stating that unless c ause is shown to the 
contrary, HFL will be struck off the register and dissolved not less than 2 months from 
October 27, 2026. 
The turnover of HFL for the calendar year 2025 was Rs. 56.08 crore and its contribution to the 
consolidated turnover of the Company for the financial year 2025-26 was 0.0048%. It had Nil 
networth as on December 31, 2025. 
The above intimation was received by the Company on October 28, 2026 at 3:11 p.m. (IST).
